_doc: Catalogue of interactive figure types. Authors write ':::widget <type>' blocks with 'key: value' lines; tools/build.js validates them against this file. Param types: expr (expression in 'vars', plus slider names), exprs (';'-separated exprs), cexpr (complex expression in z), num (number or constant expression like pi/2), int, bool, range ('min, max'), enum (one of 'values'), str, list (';'-separated strings), points ('x,y; x,y'), sliders ('a=1:-3:3:0.1; b=…' = value:min:max[:step]), matrix ('a,b; c,d' rows separated by ';'). Every type also accepts 'title' (str) and 'caption' (inline markup, shown under the figure).

plot.title: Function plotter
plot.desc: Graphs of one or more functions of x with optional parameter sliders, shading, marked points and a draggable tangent.

f.desc: functions of x separated by ';' (sliders' names may appear)

labels.desc: legend labels (TeX allowed), one per function

shade.desc: shade under the first function between these x values

between.desc: with shade: fill between the first two functions instead

tangent.desc: x0: draggable tangent line to the first function

plot.example:
f: sin(a*x); a*x
sliders: a=1:0.2:3
x: -2pi, 2pi
piticks: true
plot.zh_desc: 一个或多个关于 x 的函数图像，可加参数滑块、阴影、标记点和可拖动的切线。

floatline.title: Floating-point numbers
floatline.desc: All numbers of a toy binary floating-point system on a number line; rounding of a chosen value, machine epsilon and gaps.
floatline.zh_desc: 一个玩具二进制浮点系统中所有可表示的数；演示舍入、机器精度和数间间隙。

transform2d.title: Linear maps of the plane
transform2d.desc: The grid, unit square and a vector under the matrix A; editable entries, determinant as area, eigenvectors, animation from the identity.
transform2d.zh_desc: 矩阵 A 作用下的网格、单位正方形和向量；可编辑矩阵元素，行列式即面积，显示特征向量，并从单位矩阵连续变换。

gradientdescent.title: Gradient descent
gradientdescent.desc: Iterates of gradient descent (or momentum / Newton) on the contour map of f, with learning-rate slider and loss curve.
gradientdescent.zh_desc: 在 f 的等值线图上演示梯度下降（或动量法、牛顿法）的迭代，可调学习率并显示损失曲线。

distribution.title: Probability distributions
distribution.desc: PMF/PDF and CDF of a named distribution with parameter sliders, P(a ≤ X ≤ b) shaded, mean ± sd, and an optional normal approximation.

params.desc: initial parameters, e.g. 'n=10, p=0.3' or 'mu=0, sigma=1'

distribution.example:
dist: binomial
params: n=20, p=0.3
a: 4
b: 8
normal: true
distribution.zh_desc: 常见分布的概率质量函数/密度函数和分布函数，带参数滑块、P(a ≤ X ≤ b) 阴影、均值 ± 标准差，可叠加正态近似。

montecarlo.title: Monte Carlo estimation
montecarlo.desc: Random points estimate π or ∫ f; the estimate and its error shrink like 1/√n.
montecarlo.zh_desc: 用随机点估计 π 或 ∫f；估计值的误差按 1/√n 缩小。

markov.title: Markov chains
markov.desc: State diagram of a Markov chain, a simulated walk, the distribution after n steps and the stationary distribution.
markov.zh_desc: 马尔可夫链的状态图、随机游走模拟、n 步后的分布以及平稳分布。

bayes.title: Bayesian updating
bayes.desc: Beta prior → posterior for a proportion as successes and failures arrive, or Bayes' theorem for a diagnostic test as natural frequencies.
bayes.zh_desc: 比例的贝塔先验随成功和失败次数更新为后验；或以自然频数展示诊断检验中的贝叶斯定理。

regression.title: Least squares regression
regression.desc: Draggable data points with the least-squares line (or polynomial), residuals, the fitted equation and R².
regression.zh_desc: 可拖动的数据点及其最小二乘直线（或多项式）、残差、拟合方程和 R²。

graph.title: Graphs and graph algorithms
graph.desc: A draggable graph and a step-by-step algorithm: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Prim, Kruskal, topological sort, Euler circuit or greedy colouring.
graph.example:
nodes: A; B; C; D; E
edges: A-B:4; A-C:1; C-B:2; B-D:1; C-D:5; D-E:3
algorithm: dijkstra
start: A
graph.zh_desc: 可拖动的图及逐步演示的算法：广度优先、深度优先、迪杰斯特拉、普里姆、克鲁斯卡尔、拓扑排序、欧拉回路或贪心着色。

truthtable.title: Truth tables
truthtable.desc: Truth table of a propositional formula (¬ ∧ ∨ → ↔ ⊕ or ~ & | -> <-> xor), with sub-formula columns; compares two formulas for equivalence.

compare.desc: second formula: shows whether they are logically equivalent

truthtable.zh_desc: 命题公式的真值表（¬ ∧ ∨ → ↔ ⊕），列出子公式，并可比较两个公式是否逻辑等价。

venn.title: Venn diagrams
venn.desc: Two or three sets; the regions of a set expression (∪ ∩ \ ′ or | & - ') are shaded; type a new expression.
venn.zh_desc: 两个或三个集合；对集合表达式（∪ ∩ \ ′）对应的区域着色，也可输入新的表达式。

sieve.title: Primes
sieve.desc: Sieve of Eratosthenes animation, the Ulam spiral, or π(x) against x/ln x and Li(x).
sieve.zh_desc: 埃拉托斯特尼筛法动画、乌拉姆螺旋，或 π(x) 与 x/ln x、Li(x) 的比较。

modular.title: Modular arithmetic
modular.desc: Clock arithmetic, addition / multiplication tables mod n, powers mod n (orders, primitive roots) and inverses.
modular.zh_desc: 时钟算术、模 n 的加法/乘法表、模 n 的幂（阶与原根）以及逆元。

euclid.title: Euclid's algorithm and the CRT
euclid.zh: 欧几里得算法与中国剩余定理
euclid.desc: The (extended) Euclidean algorithm as a table and as squares tiling a rectangle; or a system of congruences solved by the Chinese remainder theorem.

system.desc: for crt: 'a mod m' items, e.g. '2 mod 3; 3 mod 5; 2 mod 7'

euclid.zh_desc: （扩展）欧几里得算法的步骤表及用正方形铺满矩形的图示；或用中国剩余定理求解同余方程组。

permutation.title: Permutations
permutation.desc: A permutation as an arrow diagram and in cycle notation, its sign and order; composition with a second permutation.
permutation.zh_desc: 以箭头图和轮换记号表示置换，给出符号与阶；可与第二个置换复合。

pascal.title: Pascal's triangle
pascal.desc: Pascal's triangle with entries coloured by residue mod m (Sierpiński patterns) and hover identities.
pascal.zh_desc: 按模 m 余数着色的帕斯卡三角形（谢尔宾斯基图案），悬停显示组合数恒等式。

cantor.title: Countability
cantor.desc: The zig-zag enumeration of ℕ×ℕ and of the positive rationals, or Cantor's diagonal argument building a sequence missing from any list.
cantor.zh_desc: ℕ×ℕ 与正有理数的“之”字形枚举，或构造一个不在任何列表中的序列的康托尔对角线论证。

mapping.title: Functions as arrow diagrams
mapping.desc: A function between finite sets as arrows; reports injective / surjective / bijective and draws the inverse or a composition.

then.desc: optional second map g from the codomain to 'target', e.g. 'a>x; b>y': draws A → B → C and g∘f

target.desc: the codomain C of g (use with 'then')

mapping.example:
domain: 1; 2; 3
codomain: a; b; c
map: 1>b; 2>a; 3>c
mapping.zh_desc: 用箭头图表示有限集合之间的映射；判断单射、满射、双射，并画出逆映射或复合。

relation.title: Relations
relation.desc: A relation on a finite set as a digraph and a 0–1 matrix (click to toggle pairs); checks reflexive, symmetric, antisymmetric, transitive and shows equivalence classes or the transitive closure.

view.desc: properties: the four properties, classes and closure; quantifiers: rows with a 1 / full columns and ∀x∃y, ∃y∀x

name.desc: letter for the relation in the read-outs, e.g. P

editable.desc: click matrix entries to toggle pairs

relation.zh_desc: 有限集合上的关系，以有向图和 0–1 矩阵表示（点击切换）；检验自反、对称、反对称、传递，显示等价类或传递闭包。
